notes.title: Bride for the Princess Full Release!
notes.notes:
Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release!

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

We also have released Digital Artbook

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34694528/7c46d5171e9d5f94de5a49da09900255f148307f.png

Dialogue

The door to the Snowtail Caverns now says it's locked instead of unable to open it

Loot

Enemies in Snowtail Caverns now drop Health Brews instead of Moonlight Flowers

Lightning

Some lightning effects were causing graphic glitches, they have been removed

NPCs

Added more NPC pets to towns

Quest

Brawnyne now straight up tells you where you need to go at the start game
